text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa is on a bear trend and looks set for an attack on support, technical analysts said.
Traders said benchmark September was due to open unchanged to two stg up after sterling's sharp fall. Sterling has broken below $1.62 to hit 12-week lows.
"The market is clearly in a bear trend," said Darren Gurner, technical analyst at Sucden.
"If it moves lower we must expect a test of 965 stg," he said, referring to the low reached by benchmark September on July 24.

"Reasonable rains in the Ivory Coast in July suggest that the main crop forecasts which will be leaking on to the market over the next few days are likely to be on the large side," brokers GNI said. "This is clearly weighing on prices at present."
New York cocoa futures ended lower and toward the bottom of the day's range for the second day in a row on Tuesday, pressured by continued speculative long liquidation, dealers said.
